answer: Each identity draws a lot from the ocean pool, locking 75 credits plus a 10 fee, as a basalt ticket binding one key, task, and required delta. It must deliver that task; auditors recompute its delta from ticket and output, and a swapped task, shared ticket, or out-of-range delta burns the bond and bars the key. The thousandth fake pays 85; 1,000 fakes cost 85,000, with no batch discount because lots are drawn at random and cannot be farmed in advance. A rented ticket fails, as the rented key cannot sign the draw. An honest agent draws once, pays 85, and reclaims the bond after delivery.
